method.gpu_peak: Maximum sampled nvidia-smi memory.used; may miss short peaks; includes other GPU processes.
method.ram_peak: Linux process VmHWM, resident memory high-water mark; not a minimum required system RAM measurement.
method.client_time: Queue submission through completion polling and MP4 download; excludes software installation and initial input upload.
method.server_time: ComfyUI execution_start to execution_success; second run reused input conditioning cache.
